items.exampleEn: My grandmother sewed new cuffs onto my favorite old shirt.
items.exampleZh: 奶奶幫我最喜歡的那件舊襯衫縫上了新袖口。

items.exampleEn: The old palace is full of gold ornaments.
items.exampleZh: 那座古老的宮殿裡滿是金色的裝飾品。

items.exampleEn: She painted her fingernails bright red for the party.
items.exampleZh: 她為了派對把指甲塗成亮紅色。

items.exampleEn: The famous painter is known for his long, curly mustache.
items.exampleZh: 那位知名畫家以他又長又捲的鬍子聞名。

items.exampleEn: This soap has a fresh fragrance.
items.exampleZh: 這塊肥皂有清新的香氣。

items.exampleEn: The baby's eyelids were closed, and she was breathing softly.
items.exampleZh: 寶寶闔著眼皮，輕輕地呼吸著。

items.exampleEn: The cook filled each bun with meat and vegetables.
items.exampleZh: 廚師在每個小圓麵包裡包滿了肉和蔬菜。

items.exampleEn: These thin cotton pajamas are perfect for hot summer nights.
items.exampleZh: 這套薄棉睡衣很適合在炎熱的夏夜穿。

items.sentenceEn: Please roll up your cuffs before you wash the dishes.
items.sentenceZh: 洗碗之前，請把袖口捲起來。

items.audioEn: The perfume shop downstairs is giving free samples of a new fragrance.
items.audioZh: 樓下的香水店正在送新香氛的免費試用品。
items.questionZh: 樓下的香水店在做什麼？

items.sentenceEn: My little brother fell asleep in his pajamas on the sofa.
items.sentenceZh: 我弟弟穿著睡衣在沙發上睡著了。

items.sentenceEn: She tapped her fingernails on the table while she waited.
items.sentenceZh: 她一邊等，一邊用指甲敲著桌子。

items.stemEn: He grew a ____ to look older, but it made him look like his father.
items.stemZh: 他留了鬍子想看起來成熟一點，結果看起來像他爸爸。

items.stemEn: When you are very tired, your ____ start to feel heavy.
items.stemZh: 人很累的時候，眼皮會開始覺得沉重。

items.passageEn: My grandfather is very particular about his appearance. Every morning, he trims his gray mustache and checks that the cuffs of his shirt are clean. He keeps his fingernails short and neat. My grandmother, on the other hand, loves pretty things: she collects tiny glass ornaments and always wears a light fragrance of roses. She ties her long hair in a bun. On Sunday mornings, they both stay in their pajamas until ten and eat sweet buns from the bakery for breakfast. My grandfather jokes that his eyelids are too heavy to get up early on weekends!
items.passageZh: 我爺爺對外表非常講究。每天早上，他都會修剪灰色的鬍子，並檢查襯衫袖口是否乾淨。他把指甲剪得又短又整齊。我奶奶則喜歡漂亮的東西：她收集小巧的玻璃擺飾，身上總是帶著淡淡的玫瑰香氣。她把長髮綁成髮髻。星期天早上，他們倆都穿著睡衣待到十點，早餐吃麵包店買來的甜麵包。爺爺開玩笑說，週末他的眼皮太重了，起不了早！

questions.questionZh: 爺爺每天早上會做什麼？
options: 去附近的公園散步一小時
去附近的麵包店買麵包

questions.questionZh: 星期天早上他們吃什麼當早餐？

items.promptZh: 他的白襯衫袖口上沾了咖啡。
referenceEn: There is coffee on the cuff of his white shirt.
His white shirt has a coffee mark on the cuff.
rubricZh: cuff 指「袖口」（例如 the cuff of his shirt）
「沾了咖啡」可寫 there is coffee on…、has a coffee mark on… 等

items.instructionZh: 用 ornament 造一個句子，說說你家或辦公室裡的一件擺飾。
referenceEn: I have a small wooden ornament shaped like a cat on my desk.
My mother hangs colorful ornaments in the window every winter.
rubricZh: 句子要用到 ornament（例如 a glass ornament、hang ornaments）
